node.title: Re^6: Print the line with the largest number from standard input
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Anyone have a good argument for preferring -Mstrict -Mv5.10 against -Mv5.12 ??

Personally I'd use -wMstrict or -wM5.012. v5.12 was released more than 9 years ago (vs. more than 11 years for v5.10), so I think it's ok to require it. (Then again, if I'm only requiring v5.10 for the // operator, I might just leave the version requirement off entirely.)

Test::More and Capture::Tiny

That's more or less how I've done it in the past, sometimes using [mod://IPC::Run3] and more recently my own module [mod://IPC::Run3::Shell]. [https://bitbucket.org/haukex/htools/src/bde3a8b03/t/csvmerge.t#lines-36|Here] is one example, along with most of the other test scripts in that directory.
